name: Steal Brainrots From Police 👮
desc:
How many Brainrots can you steal?
Just don’t get caught by the police guarding the base 😡

• Sneak into a base and grab a Brainrot 🤫
• Evade the police hot on your trail 👮
• Return safely to your base to earn cash 💵

📜 Join the group to leave feedback on the game!
